mcpServers.comment: Transport auto-detects HTTP or SSE based on Content-Type header

dynamicBackendRouting._comment_minimal: Minimal example: disabled with empty allowlist (denies all dynamic routing)

_comment_full_example._explanation_enabled: Set to true to enable dynamic backend routing
_comment_full_example._explanation_headerName: HTTP header to read backend hostname from (must be valid HTTP header name)
_comment_full_example._explanation_allowlist: List of allowed backends - supports wildcards (*.example.com), exact matches, and IP addresses if allowIpAddresses=true
_comment_full_example._explanation_denyByDefault: If true, only allowlisted backends are permitted (recommended for security)
_comment_full_example._explanation_defaultPort: Port to use if not specified in header (default: 443 for HTTPS)
_comment_full_example._explanation_allowIpAddresses: If true, allow IP addresses in allowlist and header values
_comment_full_example._explanation_allowInsecureProtocol: MVP: always false (HTTPS only); future: allow HTTP for internal backends
